# True Glow

> True Glow offers personal colour analysis (Farbberatung / Farbanalyse / analyse des couleurs) with Pauline Rigaudy, trained at Red Leopard, London. In-person sessions at a studio in Oberwil bei Zug, serving clients across all of Switzerland. Sessions in English, French and German.

## Services and prices
- Colour analysis for women, 3 hours: CHF 490 (full seasonal analysis, 36-colour rating sheet, star and impact colours, makeup and jewellery guide, personal colour pack)
- Men's session, 2 hours (colour and jewellery): CHF 325
- Duo session for two friends or a couple, 3-5 hours: CHF 350 each
- Group events: on request
- Corporate workshops and keynotes (Colour, Style & Professional Presence) anywhere in Switzerland: on request
